name: Steamed Celeriac Root Mash (Celery Root Alternative)
whyItWorks: Knobby celeriac root trimmed deeply of all outer rough peel, cubed, boiled soft, and pureed smooth. Delivers all the savory aromatic flavor of celery without the dangerous stringy cellulose fibers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Slice off all rough exterior peel with a knife. Cube white flesh, boil in salted water for 20 minutes until tender, and puree with olive oil and broth.
